pages.raw_meta: Olin is a global manufacturer of specialized chemical products and ammunition that employs 6,300 employees in more than 20 countries. We are OLIN and this is our story.
raw_blocks: From our beginnings in East Alton to the world’s No. 1 chlorine producer, we are a success story more than 130 years in the making.
From our beginnings in East Alton to the world’s leading producer of chlorine and small caliber ammunition, we are a success story more than 130 years in the making.
HUMBLE BEGINNINGS TO GLOBAL SUCCESS

Olin Corporation began in 1892 as a small blasting powder supplier in East Alton, Illinois. Following a few decades of success, along with some fruitful acquisitions, Olin has grown and expanded to encompass three business units —Olin Chlor Alkali Products & Vinyls, Olin Epoxy, and Winchester Ammunition.
Collectively, these business segments employ 7,700 professionals in more than 15 countries with customers in nearly 100 countries across the globe.
Largest producer of small caliber ammunition
Global chlor alkali producer with largest chlorine capacity
Global producer of membrane caustic soda and chlorinated organics
Global supplier of epoxy materials
North American seller of chlorine, bleach, and hydrochloric acid
in caustic, epoxy and chlorinated organics
chlorine envelope of any North America producer
Olin’s success is grounded in its commitment to operating with integrity every day. Our company Values guide every decision and action by our employees.

pages.raw_title: Products Improving Our World - Olin® Corporation
pages.raw_meta: Olin Corporation is a global manufacturer and distributor of chemical products and a leading U.S. manufacturer of ammunition. Our worldwide commitment to continuous innovation, superior safety and exceptional service ensures customer success throughout the chemical value chain and beyond.
raw_blocks: Discover how Olin products enable a healthier, safer, and more productive world.
OLIN ALLYL CHLORIDE & EPICHLOROHYDRIN
Manufactured in Stade & Freeport, these are critical ingredients for wastewater treatment, protecting our health and ecosystems.

Olin donates thousands of gallons of bleach produced in our Augusta, Becancour, Charleston, Freeport, Henderson, Lemont, McIntosh, Niagara Falls, & Santa Fe Springs sites to aid communities with disaster relief efforts to disinfect flood-damaged property.
Manufactured in Becancour, Charleston, Freeport, McIntosh, Niagara Falls, Plaquemine, & St. Gabriel, this is a critical ingredient for safer drinking water.

Produced in Baltringen, Freeport, Guarujá, Pisticci, Rheinmunster, Roberta, Stade, and Zhangjiagang, these provide reliable corrosion resistance and concrete protection for longer-lasting infrastructure.

Products manufactured in our Baltringen, Freeport, Rheinmunster, Roberta, and Stade facilities are mission-critical ingredients for Composite Pressure Vessels, which safely transport and store green energy sources like hydrogen.
Made in our Freeport & Stade facilities, this is used to make chemicals critical to the operation of wastewater treatment plants in most major cities.
Manufactured in Plaquemine & Stade, this is used in brake degreasers to remove dust and debris from brake pads and rotors, providing safer stopping distances.
Produced in Charleston, Tennessee, Olin’s KOH is used in deicing fluids to protect aircraft surfaces from ice accumulation for safer air travel.
Made in our Charleston, Tennessee, facility to help create record-setting harvests.
Produced in Becancour, Charleston, Freeport, McIntosh, Niagara, Plaquemine, & St. Gabriel, this is used to create the liquid-absorbing gel in diapers for improved sanitation and comfort.
A key ingredient used to make insulin for diabetes medication is produced only by Olin in our Stade, Germany facility.
